business_problem: L’Oréal needed to process real-time complex calculations on vast volumes of data without latency. Their existing NoSQL database lacked performance and required excessive backend scripting.
solution_summary: L’Oréal needed to process real-time complex calculations on vast volumes of data without latency. Their existing NoSQL database lacked performance and required excessive backend scripting. L’Oréal migrated to MongoDB Atlas on Google Cloud, improving data processing speed, simplifying management, and enabling seamless scalability for its tech applications. L’Oréal L’Oréal improves app performance and velocity with MongoDB Atlas The Challenge L’Oréal needed to process real-time complex calculations on vast volumes of data without latency. Our Solution L’Oréal migrated to MongoDB Atlas on Google Cloud, improving data processing speed, simplifying management, and enabling seamless scalability for its tech applications.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational data and provides the managed document database foundation for L'Oréal's workload.

data_flow: Operational events and application data flow into MongoDB Atlas, where the platform stores current state and supports real-time queries for downstream applications and integrations such as AWS, Google Cloud.
business_outcome: Latency reduced from seconds to just 10ms
